name: storyboard-os
description: Visual story-structure platform. rpg-storyboard, marketing-storyboard, and cinematic-storyboard are the three shipped verticals.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter rpg-storyboard build && pnpm --filter marketing-storyboard build && pnpm --filter cinematic-storyboard build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @storyboard-os/core build && pnpm --filter @storyboard-os/routing build && pnpm --filter @storyboard-os/rpg-domain build && pnpm --filter @storyboard-os/canvas build && pnpm --filter @storyboard-os/marketing-domain build && pnpm --filter @storyboard-os/cinematic-domain build
scripts.verify: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm test && pnpm build
